product_metadata.title: Bungalow Glow Pikake Lei Wood Candle, 1 EA
features: Uses soy wax from the United Staes
Burns for up to 30 to 40 hours
description: The scents of paradise become an instant reality with these tropical scented candles. Handmade in Hawaii with using natural tropical scented oils, phthalate-free fragrances and 100% soy wax poured in an acacia wood poi bowl. The bowl may be reused for your special trinkets. Burn for no more than four hours at a time. Burns approximately 30 to 40 hours when burned as instructed.

details.Special Feature: Burn within sight. Keey away from things tht catch fire. Keep away from children and pets. Remove ribbon before burning. Keep wax pool free of debris including matches and wick trimmings. Stop burning when 1/2" wax remains. Trim wick to 1/4" each time candle is lit. Avoid drafty areas. Do not burn candles for more than four hours at a time.
